name: Tor Project metrics services
tier_rationale: The Tor Project, Inc. is an established non-profit that publishes its network data under stated licences (A8 trusted); P040 trusted and P057 cond 5 'trusted - ... Tor Project ExoneraTor'.

reliability.justification: Authoritative Tor network data published by the Tor Project: TorDNSEL exit lists, relay consensus data through Onionoo and CollecTor archives.

exit_list.title: TorDNSEL bulk exit list check.torproject.org/torbulkexitlist

terms.quote: Tor Metrics attribution (CC0/CC BY) in THIRD_PARTY_NOTICES.md.

exit_list.notes: Quote: binding council text (P040 cond 7); research C0093 terms '[design_ceos] Tor Project public data (CC0/CC-BY per Tor metrics)' (verified_live 200). Tor Metrics (checked 2026-11-26): 'Data on this site is freely available under a CC0 no copyright declaration'. check.torproject.org/torbulkexitlist as a 1 h dataset matched locally (tor_exit_local, disclosure none, P040 cond 1); older than 6 h it is refreshed, otherwise could not verify (P040 cond 7). Used by tor_relays.

onionoo.title: Onionoo relay search (details, summary)

terms.quote: Tor Metrics attribution (CC0/CC BY) in THIRD_PARTY_NOTICES.md.

onionoo.notes: Quote: binding council text (P040 cond 7); research C0094 terms 'Tor Project (public data)' (verified_live 200). onionoo.torproject.org/details?search= and /summary?search=: only IPs that matched the local exit list or running-relay summary are sent, filtered to the exact IP client-side; operator contact fields are dropped at ingestion (P040 cond 2); If-Modified-Since (P040 cond 7). Used by tor_relays (tor_onionoo).

collector.title: CollecTor exit lists (recent and archive)

terms.quote: Tor Metrics attribution (CC0/CC BY) in THIRD_PARTY_NOTICES.md.

collector.notes: Quote: binding council text (P040 cond 7); research C0465 terms 'Tor Metrics data is public (CC0-like); mthcht/awesome-lists MIT.' (verified_live 200). collector.torproject.org/recent/exit-lists/ and /archive/exit-lists/ monthly tarballs through the core safe_extract helper; archives larger than 5 MB only through `v3lum data update`, never mid-scan (P040 cond 3-4). Used by tor_relays.

exonerator.title: ExoneraTor on metrics.torproject.org (manual pivot links)

terms.quote: Tor Metrics attribution (CC0/CC BY) in THIRD_PARTY_NOTICES.md.

exonerator.notes: Quote: binding council text (P040 cond 7: 'ExoneraTor is a manual pivot link'); research C0136 (verified_live 200). metrics.torproject.org/exonerator.html?ip={ip}&timestamp={YYYY-MM-DD}: manual links only, never fetched (P057 cond 8). Used by tor_relays and pivots_ip_network.

notes: Shared seed for batches p1-G02-2, p2-G14-1 (P040, P057): batches only extend it (torproject__<suffix>.json: extra sources and error markers). Lists refresh hourly at most (ttl 1 h); Onionoo with If-Modified-Since. dan.me.uk is not used (P040 cond 5) and the GitHub mirrors belong to core github. No published limits: no quota block.
